title: Anisotropic Representation Dynamics in Transformers
abstract: arXiv:2610.23242v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Small differences between internal representations can shrink or grow as they pass through a Transformer layer, affecting how information is preserved and how sensitive the model is to perturbations. Yet it remains unclear when changes in attention weights can turn a representation difference that would otherwise shrink into one that grows. We develop a \textbf{Mixture-Gated Theory of Anisotropic Representation Dynamics} that separates self-attention into value transport, query gating, and key gating. Our analysis reveals how the geometry of attended representations constrains gating and how interactions between these mechanisms can reverse contraction induced by value transport. We formalize this phenomenon as gating-induced regime switching, where a representation difference contracts under fixed attention routing but expands under full attention. translated_title: Transformers 中的各向异性表示动力学
translated_abstract: 内部表示之间的微小差异在穿过 Transformer 层时可能会缩小或扩大，这会影响信息的保留方式以及模型对扰动的敏感程度。然而，注意力权重的变化何时能够将原本会缩小的表示差异转变为扩大的差异，这一点仍不清楚。我们发展了一套混合门控的各向异性表示动力学理论，将自注意力分解为数值传递、查询门控和键门控三个组成部分。我们的分析揭示了被注意力关注的表示的几何结构如何约束门控行为，以及这些机制之间的相互作用如何能够逆转由数值传递引起的收缩。我们将这一现象形式化为门控诱导的状态切换：表示差异在固定的注意力路由下收缩，但在完全注意力下扩张。我们推导出一个充分必要的谱判据，用以证明该现象的存在性或……
tldr: 该论文提出了混合门控的各向异性表示动力学理论，将自注意力分解为数值传递、查询门控与键门控，揭示了门控机制可诱导表示差异从收缩切换为扩张的状态转换，并给出了判定该现象的充分必要谱判据。
en_tdlr: The paper develops a Mixture-Gated Theory of Anisotropic Representation Dynamics that decomposes self-attention into value transport, query gating, and key gating, showing that gating can induce regime switching—turning contracting representation differences into expanding ones—with a necessary and sufficient spectral criterion.
